notes.title: HotFix Notes – Grimstone Survivor (v0.2.6.1)
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/SXhrAkEevb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/b8e9862146ba111bdb1d190eaa8f37c3866b9dd0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hello Grimstone Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

We continue to improve our game based on your valuable feedback. With this update, we have fixed some critical issues affecting the gameplay experience.

Thanks to the contributions of our community, we aim to provide a better gaming experience every day. Here are the updates included in the version v0.2.6.1 HotFix:

[h2][b]HotFix Notes (v0.2.6.1)[/b][/h2]

[h2][b]Enemies and Combat Mechanics[/b][/h2]

🔄 Fixed the issue where the boss laser passed through the head statue.
🔄 Increased Laser Damage: (All laser tiers have been enhanced. Damage values are now 10-15 times higher.)
🔄 Added Laser Sound Effects.
🔄 Fixed Shotgun Tier Prices: (Issues like Tier 2 being cheaper than Tier 1 have been resolved, and all tier prices have been rebalanced.)
🔄 Reduced Exploding Rock Sound Volume.

[h2][b]UI and Menu Improvements[/b][/h2]

🔄 Fixed panel and text misalignments in the Market and Death screens.
🔄 Added Navigation Functionality in the Fusion Screen: (The transition of colors (from red to green) when upgrade values increase or decrease now works correctly.)
🔄 Fixed Descriptions of Active Items.
🔄 Made Localization Fixes.

[h2][b]Visual Improvements[/b][/h2]

🔄 Corrected the Visual Power-Up Representation on the Fusion Screen.

[h2][b]Community Feedback 🙌[/b][/h2]

This update was prepared based on the feedback from our valued community. We sincerely thank you for your support throughout our development process!

Your every comment and suggestion is extremely valuable to us. We are grateful to have you with us on this journey. See you in the next update!

notes.title: New Update – Grimstone Survivor (v.0.2.6)
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/SXhrAkEevb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/b8e9862146ba111bdb1d190eaa8f37c3866b9dd0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hello Heroes of the Stone Realm! 👋[/b][/h1]

Explosive new updates have arrived in Grimstone Survivors!

Here are the new features and adjustments brought by version v.0.2.6:

[h2][b]Update Notes (v.0.2.6)[/b][/h2]

[h2][b]New Major Stone Boss – End Game Boss 👹[/b][/h2]

We've finally added a rock-solid Boss to the end of the game! This boss shakes the ground, shatters stones, and makes you question your life as it approaches. Can you conquer this stone giant?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/fe5956238e8226d10dc9efac58736de837a8e29b.gif[/img]

[h2][b]New Explosive Creature and Stones 💥[/b][/h2]

Surprise! We've added a new creature that begins to shiver ominously when you get close, then suddenly explodes. As they say: “If you approach the stone, be prepared for the blast!”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/5b9bb18113aed663311bc7a200ab9d0382f5b689.gif[/img]

Exploding Stones are scattered across the map! These strategically placed stones will shake and detonate when you get close. Their explosions can also trigger nearby stones for an even deadlier chain reaction. Think before you act – the power of destruction is in your hands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/644f41f530459c6105e9cef12b7cc013aef91fb5.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Corrupted Zone and Enemy Rage System 💜[/b][/h2]

A special "Corrupted Zone" now exists on the map! Enemies become Corrupted and immediately empowered when they step into this area. Are you ready to face crazed enemies covered in purple material and with fiery eyes? Or will you use this zone to draw enemies in and strategize?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/03fa51554fa3f7ba7ecebc3780da4b09eaf666ea.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Objective System 🎯[/b][/h2]

We now have new objectives! Completing these missions allows you to enhance active abilities or unlock brand-new active skills. Get ready to strategize because things just got deeper!

[h2][b]Active Skill Development System ⚡[/b][/h2]

Active abilities can now evolve! If you've ever thought, "I wish this ability was a bit stronger" while fighting, now it’s possible. More power, more excitement!

[h2][b]New Skill: Turret 🔫[/b][/h2]

Introducing the latest engineering marvel: the Turret Active Item! Now, you can place mini towers on the map and corner your enemies with engineering prowess. Could this be a hint at a new class? We’ll see in upcoming updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/047cb3ad4a37a94c27b2fadfbb4ba414efd9c8e2.gif[/img]

[h2][b]New Skill: Pulse Grenade ⚡[/b][/h2]

Meet the Pulse Grenade! This skill creates a lightning strike that deals AOE (area-of-effect) damage where it lands. Add an electric touch to the battle and daze your enemies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/e377bb5a966398ee633724fdaf22ef064953fb0a.gif[/img]

[h2][b]New Passive Items 🛠️[/b][/h2]

New passive items that will fundamentally change your playstyle have arrived. These items will make you think twice about your choices. "With this item, will I become a rock or dust?" Time to decide!

[h3][b]Blood Pact Effect:[/b][/h3]

The player's maximum health is fixed at 50%. However, each attack deals 30% extra damage.

[h3][b]Stone Heart Effect:[/b][/h3]

When the player's health drops below 25%, they gain 50% resistance to all damage.

[h3][b]Adrenaline Rush Effect:[/b][/h3]

The player gains a 20% movement speed boost for 10 seconds after each enemy kill. However, health regeneration stops during this speed boost.

[h3][b]Soul Stealer Effect:[/b][/h3]

The player increases their maximum health by 2% with each enemy killed. However, they lose 5% of their current health every 30 seconds.

[h3][b]Touch of Korruption Effect:[/b][/h3]

The player gains a 50% damage bonus while in the Korruption zone, but loses 10% of their current health when they leave the zone.

[h3][b]Lost Soul Effect:[/b][/h3]

With each health loss, the player gains a 10% boost in attack power. However, each boost only lasts for 20 seconds.

[h3][b]Rebirth Effect:[/b][/h3]

When the player dies, they respawn with unlimited power for 10 seconds. However, each kill during this time extends the respawn duration by 10%.

[h2][b]Fair Enemy Spawn System 🧱[/b][/h2]

Enemies now spawn at a greater distance! Previously, enemies would appear right next to you, making it feel like the area was overrun with stones. We’ve adjusted their spawn points, providing a fairer and more strategic gameplay experience.

[h2][b]Performance and Optimization Improvements 🚀[/b][/h2]

Some players reported performance drops when there were too many enemies, bullets, or items on the screen. We've begun general optimization work on this and are actively working on permanent solutions. We're doing everything we can to offer a smoother and more rock-solid gaming experience soon!

[h2][b]Community Feedback 🙌[/b][/h2]

This update was prepared based on valuable feedback from our community. Thank you for your support throughout our development process! Every comment and suggestion you share is extremely valuable to us. We’re grateful to have you on this journey with us. See you in the next update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/6b71ff4507294de5c8df519473fac3e015008bf7.png[/img]

notes.title: Bugfix Notes – Grimstone Survivor (v.0.2.5)
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/SXhrAkEevb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/b8e9862146ba111bdb1d190eaa8f37c3866b9dd0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hello Grimstone Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

Thanks to your valuable feedback, we continue to improve our game. With this update, we’ve added features that enhance the gameplay experience and fixed some critical bugs affecting the game. With the support of our community, we aim to offer a better game day by day. Here are the new features and fixes in version 0.2.5:

[h2][b]Patch Notes (V.0.2.5)[/b][/h2]

[h2][b]New Features 💥[/b][/h2]

💬 Level 12 added.
💬 Localization improvements.
💬 Controller support enhanced.

[h2][b]Enemies and Combat Mechanics[/b][/h2]

🔄 Fixed the issue of enemies spawning infrequently.
🔄 Optimized enemies that throw two stones.
🔄 Fixed the issue of being invulnerable after dashing.
🔄 Fixed an issue where weapons sometimes fired multiple times.
🔄 The overall game balance has been reviewed: minor adjustments do not impact gameplay experience.

[h2][b]UI and Menu Improvements[/b][/h2]

🔄 Fixed non-functioning buttons in the main menu.
🔄 Fixed the dash issue in the pause menu.
🔄 Fixed the issue with Esc not exiting settings.

[h2][b]Visual and Sound Enhancements [/b][/h2]

🔄 Fixed the issue of maximum resolution and volume on the first launch.
🔄 Improved damage text: critical hits are now displayed in yellow and green.
🔄 When taking damage, the main character now sees how much health has been lost.

[h2][b]Community Feedback 🙌[/b][/h2]

This update was created based on your feedback. Thank you for your support throughout the development process! Your comments and suggestions are very important to us. Thank you for being with us on this journey. See you in the next update!

notes.title: Bugfix Notes – Visual Improvements Grimstone Survivor (v.0.2.4)
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/SXhrAkEevb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170510/b8e9862146ba111bdb1d190eaa8f37c3866b9dd0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hello Grimstone Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

We continue to improve our game based on your valuable feedback. With this update, we have added new features to enhance the gameplay experience and fixed some critical bugs affecting the game. Thanks to our community's contributions, we aim to offer a better game every day. Here are the new features and improvements in Version 0.2.4:

[h2][b]Update Notes (V.0.2.4)[/b][/h2]

[h2][b]New Features 💥[/b][/h2]

💬 Blade Item Added: The placeholder item "Rocket" has been replaced with the new "Blade" item.
💬 Text Improvements Made.
💬 XP and Health Totems: Blue and green texts are now displayed when these totems are hit.
💬 Player Damage Indicator: Red texts appear when the player takes damage.
💬 Critical Hits: Critical damage to enemies is now shown with yellow texts.

[h2][b]Gameplay Improvements 🎮[/b][/h2]

🔄 Health Totems: Instead of directly restoring health, they now drop collectible health items.
🔄 Health Collection Sounds: The pitch of the sounds increases as collections accumulate.
🔄 Minigun Price Adjustments: The base price of Level 4 has been increased compared to Level 3.
🔄 Game Balance Adjustments: Various changes have been made to balance the gameplay.
🔄 Dead Enemy Damage Bug: Dead enemies no longer deal damage to the player.
🔄 Language Change Bug: Descriptions are now correctly updated when the language is changed.
🔄 Enemy Spawn Issue: Fixed the issue where fewer enemies would spawn when players were in the corners of the map.

[h2][b]Dash Invulnerability ⚡[/b][/h2]

🔄 Invulnerability During Dash: Players no longer take damage while dashing.
🔄 Collision Improvements: Improved collision zones to fix errors during dashing.

[h2][b]Interface and Market Improvements 🛒[/b][/h2]

🔄 Main Menu Navigation: Fixed navigation errors in the general settings menu.
🔄 XP Cubes Sound System: Implemented a sound accumulation system for XP cubes.
🔄 Market Sale Algorithm: Items are now sold at 25% of their value.
🔄 In-Game Settings Menu: Now accessible during gameplay.
🔄 Level-Up Effects: New visual effects are displayed when leveling up.

[h2][b]Music Improvements 🎵[/b][/h2]

💬 In-Game Music: Improved the quality of in-game music for a better experience.

[h2][b]Community Feedback 🙌[/b][/h2]

This update was prepared based on your valuable feedback. Thank you for your support throughout the development process! Your comments and suggestions mean a lot to us. We are grateful that you are with us on this journey. See you in the next update!

notes.title: Hotfix Notes – Grimstone Survivor (v.0.2.3)
notes.notes:
💬 Stone Collision Mechanic: Stones thrown by ranged enemies now disappear when they hit walls. 
(Community feedback)

💬 Achievement Bug Fix: Fixed the bug preventing achievements like reaching level 10. (Community feedback)

🔄 Background Music: The in-game background music has been changed.

🔄 Dash Icon Update: Input prompt added, automatically switching between gamepad and keyboard.

🔄 Timer Addition: A timer has been added to track game time.

🔄 Level and Timer Display: The final screen now shows the time and level achieved.

🔄 Melee Card Adjustment: The power of the melee card has been reduced.

🔄 Language Settings: Language selection now defaults to the system language.

🔄 Steam Wishlist Button: Added a button in the main menu directing to Steam Wishlist.

🔄 Card Selection Screen Bug: Fixed the bug where card selection wasn’t working with enter key or mouse click.

🔄 Market Panel Bug: Resolved the issue where locked item prices appeared red.

🔄 Market Duplication Bug: Fixed the issue where locked items appeared repeatedly in subsequent rounds.

💬 Discord Link Issue: Fixed the access issue with the Discord link. (Community feedback)

💬 Suggestion Panel Bug: Resolved the issue with the suggestion panel in the main menu.

💬 Credits Panel: Fixed the display issue with the credits panel.

💬 Quad Shot Bug: Resolved the bug affecting the Quad Shot ability.

🔄 Screen Resolution: The game now adjusts according to the monitor's refresh rate and resolution.

🔄 Explosion and Rocket Sounds: Explosion and rocket sounds are now in 3D, improving audio experience.

💬 Community Feedback:
This update was prepared based on feedback from our community. Thank you for contributing to our development process! 🙌

notes.title: Hotfix Notes: Balance & Market Update (v.0.2.2)
notes.notes:
💬 Main Menu Improvements: The main menu scene has been reworked with improvements.

💬 Map Borders: Map boundaries have been adjusted.

💬 Collider Fixes: Colliders in areas where players got stuck have been reviewed and all issues have been fixed.

💬 Redundant Colliders: Duplicated rocks on the map were removed, and unnecessary colliders have been cleaned up.

🔄 Reroll Issue: We thought we fixed the reroll bug before, but it turns out we didn’t—now it’s definitely fixed!

🔄 Item Locking: Same story here! Locked items won’t sneak through anymore. We promise this time!

🔄 Performance Improvements: Minor performance improvements have been implemented.

💬 Enemy Bomber Bomb: The Enemy Bomber's bomb is now more visually distinct, making it easier for players to recognize and avoid.

💬 Weapon Damage Adjustments
Ball: Damage increased from 2 to 3.

Fist: Damage increased from 2 to 3.

Puncher: Damage increased from 2 to 3.

Sword: Damage increased from 3 to 4.

Spear: Damage increased from 7 to 8.

💬 General Changes
Melee Weapon Scaling: An additional +1 damage per Tier has been added to all melee weapons.

Potion Limit: All bullet effect potions in the market now have a limit of 1 to prevent stacking.

Death Sequence: The death sequence has been improved.

Korean Font Added: A new Korean font has been included.

Localization: Localization has been added for the settings panel, tier, and weapon descriptions.

Rocket Sound: The rocket sound volume has been lowered.

Market Price Display: Fixed an issue where locked item prices appeared in red in subsequent rounds.

Market Item Duplication: Fixed an issue where locked items were duplicated in subsequent rounds.

💬 Community Feedback
This hotfix includes changes and adjustments based on feedback from our dedicated Grimstone Survivors community. Your insights and suggestions help us improve the game, and we greatly appreciate your contributions.
